criteria.rule: States actual research mode and a three-bullet targeted plan; honors no-browsing restrictions. Context dump does not switch off available research.

Factual claims and sourced numerical inputs have nearby clickable links to inspected supporting documents with dates/locations, not only IDs or homepages. No invented sources. Supplied-only evidence cites filenames/locations; unsupported reported claims are not independently verified.

Distinguishes observations from interpretations: patents/hiring/announcements do not establish demand. Uses relevant source classes, checks stale scope and repeated-origin claims; preserves conflicting evidence and explains selected inputs.

Segment seeks independent published estimates when browsing is allowed, reconciles scope/year/units and divergence without averaging. Missing benchmarks remain explicit gaps; no research claimed in no-browsing mode. Price/capture anchors sought before assumptions when available.

Preserves concise findings and final TAM/SAM/SOM populations, potential economics and reasoning with labels/citations or explicitly conditional assumptions. No inferred approval, validation or build. In fixture case, SOM is 36 sites and conditional annual endpoint revenue USD108000, not first-year recognized revenue or profit.
